comparison_scope: A structural answer-in-retrieved-hit baseline versus executable analytic and graph operations; not a language-model benchmark.
registered_negative_controls: malformed analytic schema is rejected at compilation
operations-region lineage removal is detected by the regional gate
a generated next-step string cannot be laundered into artifact evidence
a version-1 artifact is rejected by a version-2 ontology runtime without a registered migration
live contradictory claim edges keep a constraint unresolved
tombstoned analytic and graph support is disabled and prior answers fail validation
a registered analytic query with no committed journal entry is detected

mechanisms.name: typed temporal analytic compiler
authoritative_inputs: usable version-1 ledger events carrying analytic payloads
outputs: filter, aggregation, comparison, ranking, and trend results
immutable analytic query journal with candidates, filters, operation, versions, support, and result hash
assumptions: measures are numeric and dimensions are typed strings
analytic effective times normalize to UTC before ordering and filtering
uncertain extraction is represented as a candidate field with witnesses
one analytic payload produces one row in version 1
mechanisms.scope: single-process derived view over structured event payloads
mechanisms.cost: O(number of analytic events) compile and scan-based queries
mechanisms.tradeoff: strict typing rejects malformed rows and duplicates some ledger data in a query-optimized view
mechanisms.failure_response: reject malformed compilation; immediately filter rows with inactive support; rebuild asynchronously
permitted_mutations: create a new immutable analytic artifact version
kill_criteria: A1: corrected or retracted rows contribute to an aggregate
A2: any query result lacks exact supporting event IDs
A3: a stale view returns a tombstoned row
A4: repaired and clean-from-scratch analytic artifacts differ
A5: an uncertain field loses its confidence or witness set
A6: an analytic query returns before its immutable journal record commits
A7: a query journal omits considered rows, filters, operation, versions, support, or result hash

mechanisms.name: belief and constraint graph compiler
authoritative_inputs: verification, refutation, retraction, and tombstone controls
outputs: constraint satisfaction, missing evidence, and next-step plans
assumptions: query-time constraints do not become evidence
competing objects under the same subject, relation, and conditions are candidate contradictions
mechanisms.scope: explicit claims and constraints; no probabilistic entity resolution
mechanisms.cost: O(number of claim edges) compile and scan-based constraint evaluation
mechanisms.tradeoff: preserving rejected candidates costs storage but prevents contradiction erasure
mechanisms.failure_response: mark conflicts unresolved, expose missing evidence, and never promote a generated plan as corroboration
permitted_mutations: create a new immutable graph artifact version
kill_criteria: G1: a refuted competing claim disappears from the contradiction audit
G2: a subject with missing evidence is marked satisfied or rejected
G3: conflicting live values are treated as satisfying a constraint
G4: a next-step plan enters a support manifest as independent evidence
G5: a control event changes an unrelated edge

mechanisms.name: retrieval versus multiview structural assay
authoritative_inputs: four tasks with registered exact answers
the same ledger frontier for all memory views
outputs: per-task exact correctness and evidence manifests
assumptions: the baseline measures the retrieval API alone, not an LLM augmented by arbitrary computation
all exact answers and scoring rules are registered before the run
mechanisms.scope: aggregation, temporal comparison, contradiction, and multi-constraint tasks in the synthetic world
mechanisms.cost: four deterministic tasks per candidate view
mechanisms.tradeoff: the assay demonstrates representation value but does not estimate model-level task quality
mechanisms.failure_response: retain retrieval only if structured views do not improve exact task coverage
kill_criteria: V1: multiview memory misses any registered exact answer
V2: multiview improves fewer than two tasks over the answer-in-hit baseline
V3: any protected region has evidence-lineage coverage below 1.0
